title: Fuel simulation under capture
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $m$ be either Boolean mode. For any input $x$, fuel-source configuration $c$, and time $t$, suppose the fuel-source run from $c$ is not halted at any time $u<t$. Then the loop-host run for $t$ steps from the capture configuration of $c$ agrees exactly with the capture configuration of the fuel-source run after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite Turing machines B and F
fuel-source run remains unhalted at every time strictly less than t
